name: reference-resolver-simplified-version-and-tfm-rules
body: ReferenceResolver.Resolve compares prerelease labels as whole case-insensitive strings rather than label by label as NuGet does, so ranges and floats over prerelease versions can pick a different version than a restore would. Its package-folder fallback takes the highest netstandard folder even for a net4x project, so a package whose best match is netstandard2.1 is loaded although .NET Framework cannot use it. Upgrade when prerelease ranges or floats must match NuGet exactly, or when net4x projects with netstandard2.1-only packages appear.
